How to read a Monaer pad box

  • Monaer number

    Monaer's own part code, for example M0307. One number can fit several car models.

  • Car model and chassis code

    The cars the pad fits, with the chassis code in brackets, for example Audi A8L (D5/4N).

  • Set size

    One set is 4 pieces, enough for the two wheels on one axle.

How to get Monaer pads for your car

  1. 1

    Send your car details

    Make, model, year and engine on WhatsApp. A photo of your road tax or the old pad helps.

  2. 2

    We match the part

    We check the Monaer catalogue number against your car's original part number.

  3. 3

    Fit at a workshop

    Collect from us in Skudai or have it fitted at a Monaer workshop near you.

Questions drivers and workshops ask

What if my car is not in the list?

Most cars are not online yet. Send us your car on WhatsApp and we check the full catalogue.

Where do I find my original part number?

On the old pad backing plate, your service invoice, or ask your workshop. A photo of the old pad on WhatsApp also works.
